title: go-chi chi before 5.5.0 contains an authentication bypass in middleware.SupressNotFound, which calls Match with the…
description: go-chi chi versions before 5.5.0 have an authentication bypass vulnerability in the middleware.SupressNotFound component. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to exploit the routing mechanism by requesting a mounted path that matches an outer public route suffix, thereby bypassing authentication middleware and potentially accessing tenant-scoped data.
